items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: That was Sidney Bichet, the fellow that had been playing there, and he went overseas, and we took his place.

ctx.x: Was the war going on there? Right after World War II. Right after World War II, I see. I see.
Well, that was a good job. Mm-hmm. That was Sidney Bichet, the fellow that had been playing there, and he went overseas, and we took his place.
Well, let's see. Now, let's see. Sir Oliver Bibbs, how many jobs did you play with him? Play many places with him?
